centralDecision.question: For ordinary non-RP tasks, should current minimum-role + tenant semantics be retained, or must creator/assignee/current client-wall permission constrain create/update and unassigned/clientless tasks? Identify canonical source/control authorizer and impersonation rule.
centralDecision.consequence: Do not infer creator-only, assignee-only or tenant-wide mutation permission. Pure task.create payload/result schema is ready; execution must remain unavailable until owner policy is explicit. Task.update additionally needs public action allocation.
centralDecision.notClaimed: This trace is not a security vulnerability finding or an exhaustive audit of deployed routes/RLS.
